notes.text: Moed Katan gives Giddel bar Menashya in the Rav transmission. Preserve the separate name and title as the source writes them.
The Yerushalmi gives Yose bar Menashya, supporting the local expansion.
The Bavli explicitly gives Ulla bar Menashya in the name of Avimi on the case of a bill of divorce reaching a roof.

comparisonEvidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015
